# unco_variable_entry_delete (Resource)

Idempotently removes a named entry from an Unco variable set at apply time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unco_variable_entry_delete" "example" {
  warehouse = "sample-warehouse"
  set_id    = "acc-sandbox"
  name      = "needs_import"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `set_id` (String)
- `warehouse` (String)

### Optional

- `triggers` (Map of String) Arbitrary key/value pairs that re-run the delete check when changed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
